name: Idartes
body: nosniff, framing limited to its origin, a clear description, and a sitemap. But https://www.idartes.gov.co/ sends a 301 to http://www.idartes.gov.co/es, and the canonical also names the http address.
lesson: Make every redirect and canonical use https. Search for http:// in your server config and templates.
summary: www.idartes.gov.co scores 81 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 27 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: 67 images have no alt attribute.

fix.title: 67 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 8 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 8 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4, Universal Analytics appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 7 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: The TLS certificate expires in 16 days
fix.evidence: Valid until 2026-11-04, issued by Sectigo Limited.
fix.fix: Confirm that automatic renewal is scheduled.
